TIL General Secretary of the Communist Party in China, Zhao Ziyang tried to reform China similar to Gorbachev, but after Tiananmen, was stripped of his positions and put under house arrest.

China did go through many of those reforms and introduced manufacturing modeled after pakistan. Mr. Ziyang had spent some time there and was impressed by their industriousness and saw how small shops of workers outputting a single standardized good and charging downstream producers was a positive thing. These reforms started to take place and China's market is based on it today. The problem is that the people liked these reforms too much and started to get a little bit excited about the trend of increased freedoms. It all came to a crash when the people thought that might include political freedom and so they quite innocently took to the streets to express themselves thinking the government would look at it favorably. Well China saw where this would eventually lead and decided it needed to make sure the people knew they had the freedom given to them and not any more, and they might as well not express any interest in more.

The Chinese leadership decided they had enough of the reforms. They got the benifits and didn't want the costs. They got their model of small firm manufacturing and that was good enough for them.
